## Original text

**No original discussion text is available in the supplied captures.** The HTML file is an Internet Archive Wayback Machine landing/interface page: it contains Wayback navigation, search controls, and footer text, but no Jeuxvideo.com page, thread title, posts, or replies. The TXT file is likewise only a rendering of that Wayback interface (including menus, links, and the “Please enter a valid web address” save-page message). Those site-chrome/error contents are omitted here rather than presented as the forum source.

### Retained research notes (editorial; not transcribed from the supplied originals)

The prior working notes say that the opening question concerned running out of arrows needed for ambush traps. They attribute to Quedza a distinction between story missions and ambushes for camp production; they say T_Sentenza later repeated that distinction and suggested conserving arrows through melee and pickups. The notes also mention replies about sparing enemies with Little John or using Will against resistant knights.

They separately describe a 2012 Mac-player report of an unresponsive cheat shortcut and being limited to ambushes, with no confirmed Mac-specific solution. The notes say this thread supplies evidence that confusion over production and depleted supplies predates recent Steam and GOG reports. These claims may be useful as leads, but the supplied HTML/TXT captures do not provide the underlying posts, authorship, dates, or wording needed for a faithful source transcription. Advice and reported outcomes were not independently tested.

### Access record

The intended source is the Jeuxvideo.com forum thread “probleme a sherwood” (forum 1-7514, topic 14072614). Retrieval was attempted on 2026-09-09. The supplied originals contain no post-by-post record, and no complete or partial discussion can be reconstructed from them.
